claims.claim_text: The indexed Roger H Dickens has a high-confidence identity match to an official Army enlistment record.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The indexed full name and a nonshared protected identifier agree with official Army bulk record ordinal 4384504; no employer is named.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from exact full name and nonshared protected identifier; Box 186 is unreviewed.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes wartime identity, not the immediate pre-OSS affiliation or a named civilian employer.
claims.match_notes: Identity-only crosswalk. An Army occupation code is not an employer.

claims.claim_text: The indexed Gelnn O Dickerson has a high-confidence identity match to the official Army record for Glenn O Dickerson.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The original index visibly spells Gelnn; the Army bulk entry spells Glenn. Surname, middle initial, and a nonshared protected identifier agree at bulk record ordinal 6801581.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence from nonshared protected identifier, surname, and middle initial; the transposed given-name letters are retained as an index variant, not silently corrected.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record establishes wartime identity only; it does not name a civilian employer or immediate OSS predecessor.
claims.match_notes: Preserve Gelnn as indexed; Glenn is a documented Army-record name variant. The physical Box 186 file is unreviewed.
